هذا 
المستند يوضح خطوات الفحص الشهرى
بأنظمة
الاطفاء 
(مياه - رغوية) المستخدمة فى سيارات الاطفاء

أعد 
المسودة الأولية المهندس/ أحمد محمد المهتدي قمرة و اختبرها المهندس/ علاء محمد 
شاهين و راجعها المهندس/ السعيد شعبان عبد القادر و وافق عليها السيد المهندس/ محمد 
صبري زيدان مدير عام شئون 
المحطة
و 
اعتمدها السيد المهندس/ أحمد عبد المجيد صوان رئيس قطاع محطة توليد كهرباء 
النوبارية.

راجعها و وافق على المستند المهندس 
/ مدحت محمد خاطر 
مفتش السلامة والصحة المهنية بقطاع التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة
و وافق على المستند المهندس/ سمير عبد الجليل أحمد مدير عام التفتيش الفني 
بشركة وسط الدلتا لانتاج الكهرباء و منسق الشركة لنظام معلومات اجراءات الصيانة ووثق من السيد المهندس/ محمد نجيب عبد الحي رئيس قطاع التفتيش و مراقبة الجودة 
بشركة وسط الدلتا لانتاج الكهرباء.

items:
اتباع اجراءات السلامة و الصحة المهنية للأفراد 
 و المعدات و ارتداء مهمات الوقاية الشخصية (خوذة آمان- حذاء آمان اوفرول- 
 جوانتي.......).

rows: التأكد من تجربة تشغيل سيارة الاطفاء و صلاحيتها
التأكد من أن السرينة تعمل
التأكد من أن الفلاشر يعمل
ثانيا: نظام الاطفاء بالمياه

التأكد من سلامة جسم خزان المياه و التأكد من عدم وجود 
 تآكل أو ثقوب

التاكد 
 من ملء خزان المياه.
التأكد من سلامة البلوف الحاكمة وعدم وجود تهريبات.
التأكد من إعداد الخراطيم بحيث يكون عددها 20 خرطوم

التأكد 
 من سلامة مكرات التدخل السريع (يمين و شمال)

التأكد 
 من سلامة المدفع اليدوي أعلى السيارة و تحريكه في جميع الاتجاهات.

التأكد 
 من سلامة القواذف الخاصة بالمياه العادية و المتعددة الأغراض.

التأكد 
 من سلامة وصلات السحب الخاصة بملء السيارة .

التأكد 
 من وجود عدد 4 وصلات سحب و الفانوس الخاص بها.

تشغيل طلمبة طرد المياه و تجربة المدفع و مكرات التدخل السريع (يمين و شمال) و 
 بعض خراطيم الاطفاء
 و القواذف
تجربة طلمبة سحب المياه و التأكد من سلامة وصلات السحب.
إعاده النظام كسابقه والتأكد من ان منسوب المياه مثالى
ثالثا: نظام الاطفاء بالسائل الرغوي

التأكد 
 من سلامة فحص جسم خزان السائل الرغوي و التأكد من عدم وجود تآكل أو ثق

التأكد 
 من أن منسوب خزان المياه مثالي.
التأكد من سلامة البلوف الحاكمة من وجود تهريبات.
مراجعة اعداد الخراطيم بحيث يكون عددها 20 خرطوم.
التأكد من سلامة القواذف الخاصة بالرغوي.
التأكد من أن منسوب السائل الرغوي مثالي .

تشغيل طلمبة طرد المياه و تجربة تشغيل نظام الماده الرغوية وملاحظة جودة المادة 
 الرغوى

تشغيل النظام مرة آخرى بالمياه لعمل نظافة من الرغاوى للوصلات والخراطيم 
 المستخدمة .

إعاده النظام كسابقة والتأكد من ان منسوب خزان المياه 
 والرغوى فى الحدود المسموح بها

رابعا: 
 ملحقات سيارة الاطفاء
التأكد من وجود بدل مقاومة للحريق بمشتملاتها
التاكد من وجود جهاز تنفس صناعي و صلاحيته.
التأكد من وجود معدات الانقاذ (أحبال- مقص- عتلة- بلطة......)
التأكد من صلاحية السلم الخاص بسيارة الاطفاء.

sections_en.text: This document outlines the steps of the monthly inspection of the fire-fighting systems (water — foam) used in fire trucks.

The first draft was prepared by Eng. Ahmed Mohamed El-Mohtady Qamra, tested by Eng. Alaa Mohamed Shaheen, reviewed by Eng. El-Said Shaaban Abdel Qader, accepted by Eng. Mohamed Sabry Zidan, General Manager of Station Affairs, and approved by Eng. Ahmed Abdel Meguid Sawan, Head of El-Nubaria Power Station Sector.

The document was reviewed and approved by Eng. Medhat Mohamed Khater, Occupational Safety and Health Inspector in the Inspection and Quality Control Sector, and approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Gelil Ahmed, General Manager of Technical Inspection at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company and the company's Maintenance Procedure Information System coordinator, and certified by Eng. Mohamed Naguib Abdel Hay, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company.

items: Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment, and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet — safety shoes, overalls, gloves...).

sections_en.text:
Procedures to be Carried Out
First: General procedures

rows: Make sure to test-run the fire truck and check that it is in working order.
Make sure the siren works.
Make sure the flasher works.
Second: Water fire-fighting system
Make sure the water tank body is sound and that there is no corrosion or holes.
Make sure the water tank is filled.
Make sure the control valves are sound, with no leaks.
Make sure the hoses are prepared, 20 hoses in number.
Make sure the quick-intervention reels (right and left) are sound.
Make sure the manual monitor on top of the vehicle is sound and moves in all directions.
Make sure the nozzles for ordinary and multi-purpose water are sound.
Make sure the suction connections for filling the vehicle are sound.
Make sure there are 4 suction connections and their lamp.
Operate the water discharge pump and test the monitor, the quick-intervention reels (right and left), some fire-fighting hoses and the nozzles.
Test the water suction pump and make sure the suction connections are sound.
Return the system to its previous state and make sure the water level is ideal.
Third: Foam liquid fire-fighting system
Make sure the foam liquid tank body is sound and that there is no corrosion or holes.
Make sure the water tank level is ideal.
Make sure the control valves are sound, with no leaks.
Check the hoses, 20 hoses in number.
Make sure the foam nozzles are sound.
Make sure the foam liquid level is ideal.
Operate the water discharge pump and test the foam system and observe the quality of the foam.
Operate the system again with water to clean the connections and hoses used of foam.
Return the system to its previous state and make sure the water and foam tank levels are within the permitted limits.

Fourth: 
 Fire truck accessories
Make sure fire-resistant suits with their accessories are present.
Make sure a breathing apparatus is present and in working order.
Make sure rescue equipment is present (ropes — shears — crowbar — axe...).
Make sure the fire truck ladder is in working order.

Introduction
This document outlines the steps of the monthly inspection of the fire-fighting systems (water — foam) used in fire trucks.
The first draft was prepared by Eng. Ahmed Mohamed El-Mohtady Qamra, tested by Eng. Alaa Mohamed Shaheen, reviewed by Eng. El-Said Shaaban Abdel Qader, accepted by Eng. Mohamed Sabry Zidan, General Manager of Station Affairs, and approved by Eng. Ahmed Abdel Meguid Sawan, Head of El-Nubaria Power Station Sector.
The document was reviewed and approved by Eng. Medhat Mohamed Khater, Occupational Safety and Health Inspector in the Inspection and Quality Control Sector, and approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Gelil Ahmed, General Manager of Technical Inspection at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company and the company's Maintenance Procedure Information System coordinator, and certified by Eng. Mohamed Naguib Abdel Hay, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company.
Safety Precautions
Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment, and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet — safety shoes, overalls, gloves...).
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Vehicle tool bag
Cleaning tools
Procedures to be Carried Out
First: General procedures
1. | Make sure to test-run the fire truck and check that it is in working order.
2. | Make sure the siren works.
3. | Make sure the flasher works.
Second: Water fire-fighting system
1. | Make sure the water tank body is sound and that there is no corrosion or holes.
2. | Make sure the water tank is filled.
3. | Make sure the control valves are sound, with no leaks.
4. | Make sure the hoses are prepared, 20 hoses in number.
5. | Make sure the quick-intervention reels (right and left) are sound.
6. | Make sure the manual monitor on top of the vehicle is sound and moves in all directions.
7. | Make sure the nozzles for ordinary and multi-purpose water are sound.
8. | Make sure the suction connections for filling the vehicle are sound.
9. | Make sure there are 4 suction connections and their lamp.
10 | Operate the water discharge pump and test the monitor, the quick-intervention reels (right and left), some fire-fighting hoses and the nozzles.
11. | Test the water suction pump and make sure the suction connections are sound.
12. | Return the system to its previous state and make sure the water level is ideal.
Third: Foam liquid fire-fighting system
1. | Make sure the foam liquid tank body is sound and that there is no corrosion or holes.
2. | Make sure the water tank level is ideal.
3. | Make sure the control valves are sound, with no leaks.
4. | Check the hoses, 20 hoses in number.
5. | Make sure the foam nozzles are sound.
6. | Make sure the foam liquid level is ideal.
7. | Operate the water discharge pump and test the foam system and observe the quality of the foam.
8. | Operate the system again with water to clean the connections and hoses used of foam.
9. | Return the system to its previous state and make sure the water and foam tank levels are within the permitted limits.
Fourth: 
 Fire truck accessories
1. | Make sure fire-resistant suits with their accessories are present.
2. | Make sure a breathing apparatus is present and in working order.
3. | Make sure rescue equipment is present (ropes — shears — crowbar — axe...).
4. | Make sure the fire truck ladder is in working order.
